ICS_INSIGHT_ID.description: Optional InsightCloudSec insight id to evaluate. When set, the importer runs POST /v2/public/insight/{id}/evaluation/run only against that one insight (avoids the catalogue listing call so a restricted-scope API key still works). When blank the importer first lists every visible insight via POST /v2/public/insights/list and evaluates each one. Accepts a stringified numeric id, UUID, or insight slug — whatever the tenant uses as the canonical insight identifier.

ICS_RESOURCE_GROUP_ID.description: Optional resource-group / scope id (CSV for multiple) forwarded to InsightCloudSec as the 'scopes' field on POST /v2/public/insight/{id}/evaluation/run so the tenant only paginates matching resources from that resource group / scope. Blank queries every resource group the API key can see. Accepts comma-separated values; whitespace tolerated; dedup applied.

ICS_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional minimum severity floor (info | low | medium | high | critical). InsightCloudSec does not expose a wire-level severity filter on /evaluation/run (severity is a property of the insight, not the matching resource), so this floor is enforced client-side after Faraday severity normalisation (handles the native numeric 1/2/3 scale, the Faraday-style critical / high / medium / low / informational enum, and CVSS base-score fallback). Defaults to info (no filtering).

name: rapid7_insightcloudsec
title: Rapid7 InsightCloudSec (CNAPP)
description: Rapid7 InsightCloudSec (formerly DivvyCloud) CNAPP / CSPM REST importer. Pulls insight evaluation results from an InsightCloudSec tenant via the canonical POST /v2/public/insights/list (insight catalogue) + POST /v2/public/insight/{id}/evaluation/run (per-insight matching resources) two-step pattern and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. The list endpoint paginates insight ids via limit+offset (only called when ICS_INSIGHT_ID is blank); the evaluation/run endpoint paginates the matching cloud resources per insight via limit+offset with body {"scopes": [<resource_group_ids>], "limit": N, "offset": N}. Each cloud account becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 ip because CSPM findings live on cloud accounts / resources, not on IPs) with hostnames = {accountName}@{accountId}; per-account matches attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per (insight_id, resource_id) pair with [CNAPP] engine prefix, '{insightName} on {resourceType} {resourceName} [{region}]' in the title, insight description / insight_id / resource / resource_type / resource_id / cloud_provider / cloud_account_id / cloud_account_name / region / resource_group / organization_service_id / status / severity / created / updated / first_seen / last_seen / closed / tags in the description; remediation / recommendation / resolution / solution / fix → insight remediation_steps / remediation / recommendation / resolution ladder surfaces as Faraday resolution. Refs include CWE-* (single + list + list-of-dict shapes with the CWE- prefix collapsed), ICS-Insight: {insight_id} pivot label, ICS-Resource: {resource_id} pivot label, Compliance: {framework} {section} pivots harvested from compliance / compliances / standards / frameworks (dict-with-name+section + bare-string shapes), url / console_url / cloud_provider_url / documentation_url / insight_url, and references / links / external_references URL shapes (string + dict with href / url). CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from id / name / title / description / summary / resource_name / insight_name (token-scan over free-form strings) + cve / cveId / cve_id / cves / aliases (string + list-of-string + list-of-dict shapes); deduped case-insensitively across resource + insight. Severity normalised from InsightCloudSec's numeric 1/2/3 scale (1=low, 2=medium, 3=high) and Faraday-style string enum (critical / high / medium / low / informational — also accepts Important / Major / Moderate / Minor / Information / None / Unspecified / Trivial / Negligible / Unknown) with CVSS v3 / v2 base-score bucketing as a fallback when only a numeric cvss_score / score / baseScore / risk_score / severity_score / cvss.score / cvss3.baseScore / cvss2.score is given (≤0/>10 → info, <4 low, <7 medium, <9 high, ≥9 critical); ICS_MIN_SEVERITY is enforced client-side after normalisation (no wire-level severity filter on /evaluation/run since severity lives on the insight, not the matching resource). Status mapped from resource.status (open / new / active / reopened / in_progress → open, closed / fixed / resolved / mitigated / remediated / patched → closed, suppressed / muted / ignored / dismissed / wont_fix / risk_accepted / excluded / false_positive / expired → risk-accepted) with state / resource_status / insight_status / finding_status alt keys + compact (InProgress / WontFix / FalsePositive) + dict-shape ({"name": "open"} or {"value": "closed"}) tolerated; a truthy suppressed / exempted flag overrides the raw status and forces risk-accepted (Rapid7's exemption lifecycle is the standard way to silence an insight finding without resolving it). Auth: InsightCloudSec uses a single long-lived API key minted from a service-account user (Administration -> API Keys). The key is passed to every call via Api-Key: <ICS_API_KEY> header (Rapid7's native scheme). auth_header short-circuits a pre-built Bearer <token> (or Api-Key <token>) value so federated / JWT-style credentials still work. ICS_HOST is the tenant URL (e.g. https://my-tenant.divvycloud.com for self-hosted DivvyCloud classic, https://insightcloudsec.rapid7.com for SaaS, or a regional https://us.insight.rapid7.com URL).
